title: Dense Chains, Antichains, and Universal Partial Orders Inside a Bounded Finite-One Degree
summary: We construct a nonrecursive set \(A\le_T\emptyset'\) and a uniformly computable family of sets \(C_0,C_1,\dots\), all bounded finite-one equivalent to \(A\), such that the corresponding \(1\)-degrees form a copy of the dense linear order \((\mathbb Q,\le)\). Motivated by a recent preprint of Richter, Stephan, and Zhang, which shows that bounded finite-one degrees can be as rigid as a discrete \(ω\)-chain and asks whether there are bounded finite-one degrees consisting exactly of a dense linearly ordered set of \(1\)-degrees, we introduce a block-density profile method for controlling one-one…
